18875-the-prairie-wife.title: The Prairie Wife
18875-the-prairie-wife.creator: Arthur Stringer
18875-the-prairie-wife.description: A book by Arthur Stringer. That's me, Matilda Anne! That's me falling plump into the pool of matrimony before I've had time to fall in love! And oh, Matilda Anne, Matilda Anne, I've _got_ to talk to you! You may be six thousand miles away, but still you've got to be my safety-valve. I'd blow up and explode if I didn't express myself to some one. For it's so lonesome out here I could go and commune with the gophers.

67921-poseidon-s-paradise-the-romance-of.title: _The Romance of Atlantis_
67921-poseidon-s-paradise-the-romance-of.creator: Unknown
67921-poseidon-s-paradise-the-romance-of.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. t sensuousness, the morn was taking richer glow, the streams brightening to gold, the gardens and vineyards glorifying in green; whilst hill and mountain grew alluring in shadow and color, the palaces lustrous in their tri-tinted stones, and the temples’ syenite a gleaming red that rivaled the flashing orichalcum studding domes and pinnacles.

arxiv-1911-12579.title: Word Embedding based New Corpus for Low-resourced Language: Sindhi
arxiv-1911-12579.creator: Wazir Ali, Jay Kumar, Junyu Lu, Zenglin Xu School of Computer Science and Engineering University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
arxiv-1911-12579.description: Abstract Representing words and phrases into dense vectors of real numbers which encode semantic and syntactic properties is a vital constituent in natural language processing (NLP). The success of neural network (NN) models in NLP largely rely on such dense word representations learned on the large unlabeled corpus.

arxiv-2106-10639.title: Self-energy corrected tight binding parameters for few p p -block semiconductors in the hybridized atomic orbital basis constructed from first principles
arxiv-2106-10639.creator: Manoar Hossain, Joydeep Bhattacharjee
arxiv-2106-10639.description: Abstract We present self-energy corrected tight-binging(TB) parameters in the basis of the directed hybridised atomic orbitals constructed from first principles, for nano-diamonds as well as bulk diamond and zinc blende structures made of elements of group 13, 14 and 15 in the 2 p p , 3 p p and 4 p p blocks.

arxiv-2207-04728.title: DUG Insight : A software package for big-data analysis and visualisation, and its demonstration for passive radar space situational awareness using radio telescopes Journal: Astronomy and Computing
arxiv-2207-04728.creator: Grigg, D, Tingay, S.J, Sokolowski, M, Wayth, R.B
arxiv-2207-04728.description: Abstract As the demand for software to support the processing and analysis of massive radio astronomy datasets increases in the era of the SKA, we demonstrate the interactive workflow building, data mining, processing, and visualisation capabilities of DUG Insight .

arxiv-2208-03836.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Quantum Technologies
arxiv-2208-03836.creator: Mario Krenn, Jonas Landgraf, Thomas Foesel, Florian Marquardt
arxiv-2208-03836.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mario Krenn, Jonas Landgraf, Thomas Foesel, Florian Marquardt. In recent years, the dramatic progress in machine learning has begun to impact many areas of science and technology significantly. In the present perspective article, we explore how quantum technologies are benefiting from this revolution.

Thanks: Based on observations obtained at the Observatoire de Haute Provence (OHP, France), operated by the French CNRS. 2023 Extraplanar emission in isolated edge-o

arxiv-2401-02876.description: Abstract Isolated galaxies are the ideal reference sample to study the galaxy structure minimising potential environmental effects. We selected a complete sample of 14 nearby, late-type, highly inclined ( i ≥ 80 ∘ i\geq 80^{\circ} ), isolated galaxies from the Catalogue of Isolated Galaxies (CIG) which offers a vertical view of their disc structure.

arxiv-2403-18378.title: Improvements to the theoretical estimates of the Schwarz preconditioner with Δ \Delta -GenEO coarse space for the indefinite Helmholtz problem
arxiv-2403-18378.creator: Victorita Dolean, Mark Fry, Matthias Langer †
arxiv-2403-18378.description: Abstract The purpose of this work is to improve the estimates for the Δ \Delta -GenEO method from the paper [ 2 ] when applied to the indefinite Helmholtz equation. We derive k k -dependent estimates of quantities of interest ensuring the robustness of the method.

arxiv-2408-15590.title: Bayesian optimization of atomic structures with prior probabilities from universal interatomic potentials
arxiv-2408-15590.creator: Peder Lyngby ∗ , Casper Larsen, and Karsten Wedel Jacobsen
arxiv-2408-15590.description: Abstract The optimization of atomic structures plays a pivotal role in understanding and designing materials with desired properties. However, conventional methods often struggle with the formidable task of navigating the vast potential energy surface, especially in high-dimensional spaces with numerous local minima. Recent advancements in machine learning-driven surrogate models offer a promising avenue for alleviating this computational burden.

arxiv-2409-14134.title: Distinct degrees and homogeneous sets II
arxiv-2409-14134.creator: Eoin Long, Lauren t , iu Ploscaru
arxiv-2409-14134.description: Abstract Given an n n -vertex graph G G , let hom ⁡ ( G ) \hom(G) denote the size of a largest homogeneous set in G G and let f ⁡ ( G ) f(G) denote the maximal number of distinct degrees appearing in an induced subgraph of G G .

arxiv-2501-10636.title: Efficient and Safe Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Agricultural Vehicle Headland Turning in Cluttered Orchard Environments
arxiv-2501-10636.creator: Peng Wei, Chen Peng, Wenwu Lu, Yuankai Zhu, Stavros Vougioukas, Zhenghao Fei, Zhikang Ge
arxiv-2501-10636.description: Abstract Autonomous agricultural vehicles (AAVs), including field robots and autonomous tractors, are becoming essential in modern farming by improving efficiency and reducing labor costs. A critical task in AAV operations is headland turning between crop rows. This task is challenging in orchards with limited headland space, irregular boundaries, operational constraints, and static obstacles.

arxiv-2511-13308.title: Switching rates in Kerr resonator with two-photon dissipation and driving
arxiv-2511-13308.creator: V. Yu. Mylnikov, S. O. Potashin, M. S. Ukhtary, G. S. Sokolovskii
arxiv-2511-13308.description: Abstract We analytically investigate the switching rate in a two-photon driven Kerr oscillator with finite detuning and two-photon dissipation. This system exhibits quantum bistability and supports a logical manifold for a bosonic qubit. Using Kramer’s theory together with the P P -representation, we derive an analytical expression for the bit-flip error rate within the potential-barrier approximation.

arxiv-2602-05267.title: Near-perfect matchings in highly connected 1-planar graphs with a local crossing constraint
arxiv-2602-05267.creator: Licheng Zhang, Yuanqiu Huang, Zhangdong Ouyang
arxiv-2602-05267.description: Abstract For planar graphs, it is well known that high connectivity implies a Hamiltonian cycle and hence any 4-connected planar graph has a near-perfect matching. Nevertheless, whether 6-connected 1-planar graphs admit near-perfect matchings remains largely open. The prior art established this for 4-connected 1-planar graphs only when each crossing involves four endpoints that induce a K 4 K_{4} .

pmc-10673329.description: Asthenopia is a syndrome based on the symptoms of eye discomfort that has become a chronic disease that interferes with and harms people’s physical and mental health. Lutein is an internationally recognized “eye nutrient”, and studies have shown that it can protect the retina and relieve visual fatigue. In this study, lutein was extracted from marigold (Tagetes erecta L.

pmc-11354984.title: Enhanced Efficacy of Gastric Cancer Treatment through Targeted Exosome Delivery of 17-DMAG Anticancer Agent
pmc-11354984.creator: Jung Hyun Park, Say-June Kim, Ok-Hee Kim, Dong Jin Kim
pmc-11354984.description: In this study, we explored the potential of genetically engineered exosomes as vehicles for precise drug delivery in gastric cancer therapy. A novel antitumor strategy using biocompatible exosomes (Ex) was devised by genetically engineering adipose-derived stem cells to express an MKN45-binding peptide (DE532) on their surfaces. 17-(Dimethylaminoethylamino)-17-demethoxygeldanamycin (17-DMAG) was encapsulated in engineered exosomes, resulting in 17-DMAG-loaded DE532 exosomes.

pmc-11477582.title: A Review on Pulsed Laser Preparation of Quantum Dots in Colloids for the Optimization of Perovskite Solar Cells: Advantages, Challenges, and Prospects
pmc-11477582.creator: Liang Sun, Yang Li, Jiujiang Yan, Wei Xu, Liangfen Xiao, Zhong Zheng, Ke Liu, Zhijie Huang, Shuhan Li, Candido Fabrizio Pirri
pmc-11477582.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In recent years, academic research on perovskite solar cells (PSCs) has attracted remarkable attention, and one of the most crucial issues is promoting the power conversion efficiency (PCE) and operational stability of PSCs.

pmc-11612431.title: Glutamine sensing licenses cholesterol synthesis
pmc-11612431.creator: Bruna Martins Garcia, Philipp Melchinger, Tania Medeiros, Sebastian Hendrix, Kavan Prabhu, Mauro Corrado, Jenina Kingma, Andrej Gorbatenko, Soni Deshwal, Matteo Veronese, Luca Scorrano, Erika Pearce, Patrick Giavalisco, Noam Zelcer, Lena Pernas
pmc-11612431.description: The mevalonate pathway produces essential lipid metabolites such as cholesterol. Although this pathway is negatively regulated by metabolic intermediates, little is known of the metabolites that positively regulate its activity. We found that the amino acid glutamine is required to activate the mevalonate pathway.

pmc-11695889.title: Efficacy and Safety of Continuous vs Intermittent Linezolid Infusion in Critically Ill Patients with Septic Shock
pmc-11695889.creator: Ahmed M Albadry, Hend Y Zakaria, Mai M Elhefny, Ibrahim M Elsherif
pmc-11695889.description: The synthetic antimicrobial agent Linezolid effectively penetrates many tissues and exhibits effectiveness against drug-resistant Gram-positive bacteria. This agent's pharmacokinetic qualities cast doubt on the need for intravenous treatment in cases of serious illness. For its time-dependent action to have an impact, serum levels must stay above the minimum inhibitory concentration throughout the dosage interval.

pmc-12639048.title: Root mixing effects on belowground decomposition depend on mycorrhizal type
pmc-12639048.creator: Lei Jiang, Stephan Hättenschwiler, Ning Ma, Jiajia Zheng, Wenhui Shi, Yeqing Ying, Shenggong Li, Han Yan, Liang Kou
pmc-12639048.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). While there has been significant progress in understanding how species mixing affects leaf litter decomposition, the consequences for belowground root decomposition remains less known. This represents a critical knowledge gap, as roots are key contributors to soil carbon input. Here, we experimentally assess absorptive root decomposition in 138 paired-species combinations from 57 tree species, revealing significant non-additive mixing effects in 70% of all root combinations, with the majority of them decomposing faster than predicted from single species.

pmc-13037355.title: Surface‐Sensitive Characterization of Nujol Interaction with CaCO3 (104) Surfaces
pmc-13037355.creator: Lanna I. M. Sinimbu, Jesana M. Loreto, Maria Luiza Dorneles, Igor Coelho, Emilia Annese, Fernando Stavale
pmc-13037355.description: In this study, we investigated the adsorption of Nujol, composed mainly of n‐dodecane molecules, on pristine and hydrated CaCO3 (104) surfaces by atomic force microscopy (AFM), X‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and infrared reflection‐absorption spectroscopy (IRRAS). Our results reveal changes in the molecule–calcite interaction connected to differences in the substrate surface chemical composition upon hydration.

pmc-13187070.title: [18F]FDG WBC labelled PET/CT for the diagnosis of infectious disease: initial experience in a tertiary centre
pmc-13187070.creator: Christel Hermann Kamani, Julien Costes, Maxime Panchaud, Kilian Casagrande, Giorgio Treglia, Mario Jreige, Marie Nicod Lalonde, Niklaus Schaefer, Judith Delage, John O Prior
pmc-13187070.description: BackgroundLabelling WBC with [18F]FDG may be an alternative for accurate infection diagnosis, combining the excellent sensitivity of [18F]FDG with the excellent specificity of WBC-labelled SPECT/CT. We aim to investigate the feasibility, safety and accuracy of [18F]FDG-labelled WBC in patients with suspected infectious disease.ResultsScans were performed at 131 ± 13 min and 201 ± 16 min after [18F]FDG-labelled WBC administration.

pmc-13282663.title: In vivo visualization of bioactive iron and oxygen using LiON, the labile iron and oxygen notifier
pmc-13282663.creator: Ayato Maeda, Akihiro Nita, Shoko Sashiyama, Suzu Yoshitomo, Komen Joan Jepkosgei, Yuqing Xu, Yuichiro Arima, Keiichi I. Nakayama, Kimi Araki, Toshiro Moroishi
pmc-13282663.description: SummaryIron and oxygen are essential for numerous biological processes, yet monitoring their bioactive intracellular dynamics in vivo remains challenging due to the limitations of current detection methods. Here, we introduce the labile iron and oxygen notifier (LiON), a genetically encoded, ratiometric fluorescent reporter enabling single-cell-resolution monitoring of intracellular iron and oxygen levels in vivo.

pmc-13316166.title: Cyber Military Operations under International Humanitarian Law: Interpreting the Concept of “Attack” and Challenges in Protecting Civilians
pmc-13316166.creator: Eman Hamdan, Ashraf Al-Rai, Maya Khater, Mohamad Hidayat Muhtar, Hamzeh Abu Issa, Maya Khater, Mohamad Hidayat Muhtar, Maya Khater, Abdullah M Ehjelah, Maya Khater
pmc-13316166.description: BackgroundGiven the growing use of information and communication technology across many essential industries, threats associated with military operations have emerged in cyberspace, thereby resulting in various debates concerning the extent to which International Humanitarian Law (IHL) applies to such threats.

pmc-13562181.title: Cost-Effectiveness of Endoscopic Bariatric Therapies Compared with Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy and Semaglutide
pmc-13562181.creator: Nafsika Afentou, James Hall, Chidubem Okeke Ogwulu, Esther Albon, Janine Dretzke, Malcolm Price, Ken Clare, Rishi Singhal, Abd Tahrani, David J Moore, Emma Frew
pmc-13562181.description: IntroductionEndoscopic bariatric therapies, including endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty (ESG) and intragastric balloon (IGB), are emerging as less invasive alternatives to bariatric surgery. However, their economic value relative to established treatments such as bariatric surgery and pharmacotherapy remains uncertain. This study evaluated the cost-effectiveness of endoscopic bariatric therapies compared with surgery and semaglutide from a UK health system perspective.
